package.name: nidar_autonomy
package.description: Onboard autonomy nodes for NIDAR AirMouse: command handling, mission state, ARM/DISARM (bench-verified), and mapping/exploration/telemetry (migrated from gps_denied/raj-dev -- see CHECKPOINT/CURRENT_STATE.md). Real flight-control setpoint issuance now exists ONLY for the dev-only /test_mission/* path (test_mission_node.py, gated behind explicit safety-reviewed design -- see mavros_flight_controller.py and setpoint_client.py); the real competition mission (mission_state_node.py) still never sends a setpoint -- see this repo's CLAUDE.md.
